name: threat-modeler
description: Lightweight workshop assistant that produces a threat-model artifact for an agentic system or risk-surface change

interface.shortDescription: Produce a threat-model artifact for an agentic system or risk-surface change
interface.longDescription: Workshop assistant that walks an author from risk-surface signal to a finished threat-model markdown artifact. STRIDE-style decomposition, asset/actor enumeration, data-flow description, OWASP LLM/Agentic + MITRE ATLAS + NIST AI 600-1 cross-mapping, mitigation table, residual risk, decision log. Output satisfies build-loop's plan-verify rule 10 (`risk-surface-change-without-threat-model`). Cross-LLM: Claude Code reads the natural-language description; Codex auto-activates on the metadata block.
